title: hieracium tommasinianum subsp. setosissimum
intro: Hieracium tommasinianum subsp. setosissimum, commonly known as the Seto Hawheath, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion genus. It is a member of the Asteraceae family, native to China and the Himalayas. The plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium tommasinianum subsp. setosissimum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
